info.name: ION Seller App (BPP)
info.description:
Beckn v2.0.0 callbacks the ION reference BPP sends through its ONIX adapter (bppTxnCaller), plus catalog publishing.

Set bap_id, bpp_id and networkId (and the URIs if yours differ) before running. bpp_adapter_url defaults to http://localhost:8082/bpp/caller; catalog_publish_url to http://localhost:8085 (onix-catalog-publish). To answer a real buyer request, set transaction_id to the BAP's.

Request bodies follow the schema the ONIX adapters validate against: Beckn core https://schema.ion.id/release1/schema/vendored/beckn/api/v2.0.0/beckn.yaml (plus ion-additional.yaml for /reconcile and /on_reconcile), and every object carrying @context/@type against that pack's attributes.yaml (IONTradeOffer, IONTradeConsideration, IONTradeResource, IONTradeCommitment, IONTradePerformance, IONTradeProvider, IONTradeContract, IONTradeSettlement, IONSettlementReconciliation, beckn Consumer).

All requests describe one worked order: 2 x Kemeja Batik Tulis Parang at Rp 225.000 (pre-tax), PPN 12% on a taxable base of 11/12 (Rp 24.750 per unit), Rp 10.000 delivery, total Rp 509.500. The seller's buyer finder fee is 3% of ITEM_TOTAL = Rp 13.500 commission, so the BPP's net payable is Rp 496.000.

request.description:
Sent by the BPP to the catalog publisher (onix-catalog-publish, CDS_PUBLISH_URL), not through the BPP adapter. Envelope is beckn.yaml's CatalogPublishAction: message.catalogs[] and message.publishDirectives[] (visibleTo = network ids). Every offer carries its consideration (price breakup with PPN, deliveryFee, buyerFinderFee, paymentMethods) and offerAttributes.policies (returns, cancellation, replacement, settlement terms).

Response: {status: COMPLETED, results: [{catalogId, status: ACCEPTED|REJECTED, version, reason}]}.

The selected commitments priced from the BPP's catalog: commitmentAttributes.price (unit price before tax), the offer with the stored terms (buyerFinderFee, policies.settlement, serviceability, paymentConstraints) and one contract consideration status QUOTED whose breakup is BASE_PRICE and TAX lines per item (scaled by quantity, taxDetail.taxableBase too) plus one DELIVERY_CHARGE (the highest offer deliveryFee; none for SELF_PICKUP). buyerFinderFee.feeAmount is the commission on that quote.
The init contract with the contract id the BPP assigns, the commission recomputed on its final price, and the BPP's settlementAccounts entry (holderRole BPP) added next to the BAP's.
The order is binding: contract and commitments ACTIVE, payment settlement COMPLETE.
